**1.031: No full stop at the end, a live draft, and an edit row in the voice keyboard.**

- **No full stop at the end:** a new switch on the Dictation screen, and a small "No ." chip in the voice keyboard, leaves off the final full stop of each take. Meant for searches, inventory lookups and titles. Question and exclamation marks stay, and so do full stops inside the take. Works in the keyboard and the floating mic.
- **Live draft (voice keyboard, experimental):** while you speak, the words since your last pause appear underlined in the text field and are heard again every half second, so an earlier word can change once the next ones make it clear. At a pause they are typed for good. Off by default, on the Dictation screen. Not in the floating mic.
- **Edit row in the voice keyboard:** move the cursor, delete a word or delete the last sentence without leaving the voice keyboard.
- **A take survives the keyboard hiding:** tapping a menu or another field pauses the take instead of losing it, and it carries on when the keyboard comes back. When the voice keyboard closes with nothing recording, you're returned to your regular keyboard.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
